mapper.sql: SELECT p.id, p.user_id, p.body, p.image_path, p.created_at, p.updated_at, u.username, u.display_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments c WHERE c.post_id = p.id) AS comment_count, 0 AS like_count FROM posts p JOIN users u ON u.id = p.user_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO posts (user_id, body, image_path, created_at, updated_at) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{body}, #{imagePath}, COALESCE(#{createdAt}, datetime('now')), COALESCE(#{createdAt}, datetime('now')) )
mapper.update: UPDATE posts SET body = #{body}, image_path = #{imagePath}, updated_at = datetime('now') WHERE id = #{id}
